sources.title: Fragments Of Memories — BLACK/MATRIX 00 プレイ日記
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET A candidate. Directly inspectable 43-entry play diary spanning the game through first clear and later-playthrough/endgame entries. Useful for chronological story flow, free-action events, battles, and observed ending outcomes. Needs route-by-route indexing before authoring.

sources.title: たそがれストローク — 〖BLACK/MATRIX 00〗ボーナスシナリオまとめ
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET A component. Directly inspectable and enumerates all 14 bonus scenarios with chapter/free-action placement, trigger conversation chains, cross-scenario prerequisites, the ダーナの試練 branch, and the セングラー condition for scenario 14. This closes Set A's optional-content timing gap.

sources.title: CRADLE 2 GRAVE — ブラックマトリクス OO 自動系スキル修得考察
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B component. Directly inspectable ordered battle-stage list covering 1-3 through 10-1 and useful progression cross-checks, but not a complete walkthrough by itself.

sources.title: ゲームカタログ@Wiki — BLACK/MATRIX OO
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B component for exact platform/release identity and broad ending/NG+ structure. It does not provide all optional-content triggers.

sources.title: BLACK/MATRIX総合スレッド Chapter:15
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B supplementary component with firsthand discussion of bonus scenarios and true-ending/second-playthrough requirements. Community evidence only; use cautiously and reconcile with stronger sources.

sources.title: BLACK/MATRIX・ダブルオー再評価
sources.notes: PRIMARY JAPANESE SET B component for ending mechanics. Directly inspectable firsthand write-up stating that the ordinary ending matrix is controlled by the ring that counters パスカのペインリング plus the final boss defeat/retreat decision, yielding four main patterns, with additional sub-ending content.

sources.title: PS～Black/Matrix00徹底攻略+極道研究
sources.notes: SUPPLEMENTAL ONLY. Directly inspectable detailed full walkthrough with chapter/stage ordering, free-action placement, all 14 bonus-scenario references, hidden-shop notes, ending-affecting conditions, and first-clear/NG+ information. Because it is not Japanese, it cannot satisfy Set A or Set B.

sources.title: BLACK/MATRIX OO 攻略Wiki
sources.notes: PROVENANCE ONLY FOR NOW. Search results indicate a detailed Japanese chapter/battle walkthrough, but the current fetch path returns HTTP 403, so it cannot count toward the verification gate until directly inspectable.

sources.title: ブラックマトリクス ダブルオー 公式ガイド
sources.notes: PROVENANCE ONLY. Confirms a 175-page official guide exists and advertises coverage of all scenario battles/data, but page contents are not directly inspectable through the current research path.
